name: Fire Bolt
description: A bolt of flame streaks toward a target.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A beam of freezing energy strikes a creature.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: A touch releases a burst of lightning.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Radiant fire descends upon a target; a successful Dexterity save avoids the damage.

name: Acid Splash
description: A splash of corrosive acid strikes a target; a successful Dexterity save avoids the damage.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of light strikes with radiant force.

name: Healing Word
description: A brief prayer restores a creature's vitality.

name: Burning Hands
description: Flames surge from the caster's hands; a successful Dexterity save halves the damage.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of thunderous force erupts; a successful Constitution save halves the damage.

name: Mage Armor
description: Protective magic surrounds a willing creature; AC and duration mechanics are not yet implemented.

name: Shield
description: A magical barrier flashes into place; reaction timing and AC bonus mechanics are not yet implemented.

name: Detect Magic
description: The caster senses the presence of magic; detection range and duration remain unimplemented.
